_show: Celebrity reality competition from The Traitors' producers: 12 celebrities (Harry Jowsey, Bruno Tonioli, Joe Gorga, Romeo Miller, Demi Engemann...) in an Italian villa, hosted by Parker Posey. The group picks a 'don' who decides who gets paid, stays or leaves; the others can overthrow them. Up to $250,000.
